actions.mechanism: Monotonic expiry controls freshness; expired-first, then least-recently-used eviction bounds the cache.
actions.implementation: Admit only allowlisted public fields from public sources. Set expiry at fetch start plus 300 seconds; atomically evict before insertion.
actions.check: With a fake clock, verify expiry at 300 seconds, including during outages. Insert 101 keys; assert at most 100 records.
actions.risk: Slow fetches shorten usable lifetime; discard responses already expired.

actions.action: Return an explicit error when the source times out.
actions.mechanism: A fixed source deadline prevents indefinite waiting; failures never renew records or replace them with cached errors.
actions.implementation: Set a configurable fetch deadline. On timeout, cancel retrieval and return HTTP 503 with code source_timeout. Remove any expired entry; preserve unexpired entries.
actions.check: Simulate a hanging source. Verify timely 503, unchanged expiration timestamps, expired-entry removal, and no error-record insertion.
actions.risk: Cancellation must also stop underlying network work.

actions.action: Merge concurrent misses for the same record.
actions.mechanism: One in-flight fetch per key prevents duplicate source requests; bounded admission limits outage-related request buildup.
actions.implementation: Maintain an in-flight promise map capped at a configured size. Join existing fetches; reject excess distinct misses with 503 cache_busy. Remove promises on completion.
actions.check: Send concurrent requests for one missing key: observe one source call. Force timeout; verify shared errors and an empty promise map.
actions.risk: Bound waiters too; shared fetches otherwise accumulate callers.

actions.action: Temporarily stop source calls after repeated failures.
actions.mechanism: A circuit breaker makes sustained outages explicit while still serving cached records whose original expiry has not passed.
actions.implementation: After a configured consecutive-failure threshold, reject misses with 503 source_unavailable during cooldown. Then allow one probe; never extend TTL or suspend eviction.
actions.check: Force the threshold failures; verify no source calls during cooldown, expired-record eviction, one recovery probe, and resumed fetching after success.
actions.risk: Long cooldowns delay recovery; short cooldowns repeatedly probe outages.
